info.title: Wolfari Fund Setup and Ledger
info.description: API070–077 current runtime. No schema redesign; references original specification plus Demo 1 addendum.

post.summary: API070 Enable Fund; Owner selects fixed active Holder
post.description: Active Trip membership required, current role rechecked. Writes require unarchived Trip and OPEN Fund, Trip guard and optimistic versions. Owner configures, Holder confirms consent. Unknown write outcomes retain idempotency key and payload. Web Origin/CSRF behavior follows identity.openapi.yaml. Holder is fixed until CLOSED; TEST recipient data only for local demo.

201.description: Authorized persisted projection; no balance computed from a ledger page.

202.description: Pending operation: poll API038 with initiating actor; SUCCEEDED then retry same method/body/key for receipt. FAILED/NEEDS_REVIEW are not success.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; write result can be unknown
